# arin_ticket (Data Source)

Read an existing ticket and its message references. No ticket is created. Ticket content is sensitive and stored in Terraform state.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Generated by go generate.
# Set ARIN_API_KEY in the environment.
# This data source stores sensitive content in Terraform state.
data "arin_ticket" "example" {
  ticket_number           = "20260922-X1"
  message_references_only = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ticket_number` (String, Sensitive) Existing ARIN ticket number. The API key must have access to the ticket.

### Optional

- `message_references_only` (Boolean, Sensitive) Retrieve references rather than full message bodies. Defaults to `true`.

### Read-Only

- `closed_date` (String, Sensitive) closed date returned by ARIN.
- `created_date` (String, Sensitive) created date returned by ARIN.
- `flagged` (String, Sensitive) flagged returned by ARIN.
- `message_references` (Attributes List, Sensitive) message references returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--message_references))
- `messages` (Attributes List, Sensitive) messages returned by ARIN. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--messages))
- `org_handle` (String, Sensitive) org handle returned by ARIN.
- `resolution` (String, Sensitive) resolution returned by ARIN.
- `resolved_date` (String, Sensitive) resolved date returned by ARIN.
- `shared` (Boolean, Sensitive) shared returned by ARIN.
- `ticket_status` (String, Sensitive) ticket status returned by ARIN.
- `ticket_type` (String, Sensitive) ticket type returned by ARIN.
- `updated_date` (String, Sensitive) updated date returned by ARIN.
